name: Protagonist
source: The customizable protagonist. Their name, pronouns, skin tone, hairstyle, and accessories can all be modified. They were in great need of a vacation, but as they are broke, they accepted a part-time job at the fancy beach hotel in Paciflora, in their dream location. They try to work well, but are annoyed with the job in general.
